concepts.proposed_markdown: Adyen's website basic-flow hub frames a viable integrated POS flow around payment, refund, in-progress cancellation, receipts, application details, and transaction-status recovery when a response is missing. It links PaymentRequest, ReversalRequest, AbortRequest, and TransactionStatusRequest as routes, but the hub does not specify all refund variants or the API ownership of optional industry features. Detailed behavior belongs to each linked operation/source and independently versioned implementation evidence.
warnings: Do not interpret the hub's broad ReversalRequest refund mapping as all refund variants; the existing concept notes an unreferenced refund payment pattern in exact-commit Postman examples.
